scope: Exact new sources, generated C/images, complete outputs, profiles, failures, methods and closure/pruning receipts. Content-identical files share one archive payload. restore: Read INDEX.json, verify each payload SHA256/bytes, then restore each alias only into an absent path and apply its saved mode. Never overwrite frozen artifacts.
